akash: FYI canary 17399 showing a small but consistent bump in funcall parse failures on the new int8 onboarding run. canary-bot: report -> https://infradash/canaries/17399  failure-rate=2.7% baseline=0.15% :warning:
rebecca: what changed in the build?
akash: quant config: per-channel int8 + clip=0.9, batching window reduced 60ms->25ms to test latency. no prompt or tokenizer change.
yvonne: sample failure:
ERROR: JSONDecodeError: Expecting value at line 1 column 1
RESPONSE_PREVIEW: "\\u0002{\"action\":\"create\",\"args\":{}}"
leading 0x02 in several traces.
rebecca: 0x02 usually from token shift at sequence start. could be encoding table or streaming chunk boundary.
akash: runtime metrics show higher chunk variance after batching tweak. kv-cache on for canary.
yvonne: quick mitigations:
- deploy a cheap streaming prefix-guard: drop leading bytes <=0x1F before json parse (config flag on canary only)
- add first-token histogram logging for 0.5% of traffic
- run kv-cache on vs off microbench with same prompts
rebecca: scrub ok short-term but keep raw capture so we can debug root cause. add onboarding gating: reject quant model if any nonprintable-leading-token rate > 0.1% on 10k sample.
akash: I'll flip batch-window back to 60ms now and push scrub flag. yvonne: opening scrub PR and unit test to ensure idempotence. canary-bot: scrub deploy started commit=c9d8 est=4m
rebecca: thanks. once microbench completes we should decide if kv reuse needs a guard for quant payloads. reconvene 11:00 PT.
